files.description: The sole EHI export documentation for BlueEHR 3. A 2-page PDF (cover page + 1 content page) describing three export mechanisms: (1) Clinical data via C-CDA using the Care Coordination feature, (2) Demographics, lab, insurance, and payment data via CSV/XLS using the Analytics feature, and (3) Patient documents via the document module. Contains two screenshots of the export interfaces. No data dictionary, no field definitions, no schema, no sample exports.

Screenshot of the certifications and costs page showing the documentation links section, including the 'Electronic Health Information Export' link, API Documentation, FHIR Documentation, FHIR URLs, API Reference, and Additional Types of Costs links.
